.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/create/.instruction: Run `{{script}} <name>` where `<name>` is the class id (any case; it is converted to PascalCase) to scaffold the class file.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/list/st.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] to list all classes, optionally filtering to only those whose file contents include the given searchTerm.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/update/.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> with the class's id as the argument to verify the class exists before proceeding.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/delete/.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> with the class's id (e.g. its kebab/camel-case name) as the argument.
Run {{script}} <id> with the class's id (the same id used to create/delete it) to print every remaining reference as `[file path]:[line number]`.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/evaluat.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the class identifier to evaluate (e.g. `{{script}} my-class`).

create.text: Scaffolds a new class file at src/src/classes/{Name}.class.ts with a minimal class definition, given an id and optional initial content.

list.text: Lists all classes defined in the codebase, optionally filtered by a search term, printing each as "[id]: [file path]".

update.text: Updates an existing class artifact's source file according to a given id and natural-language change request, erroring if the class doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes the class artifact with the given id from src/src/classes, removing its file and cleaning up any dangling references to it in the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a class artifact's file, structure, and shape comply with the artifact rules, given the class's id, and reports pass/fail with any discrepancies.
